question: The Red-Fort construction was begun in 1639 and completed after ____ years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**9**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The construction of the **Red Fort** (Lal Qila) was commissioned by the **Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan** on **13 May 1638**, when he decided to shift his capital from **Agra** to **Delhi**.
 
• While the site preparation began earlier, the actual construction process is widely cited to have started in **1639**.
 
• The massive fort project was completed in **1648**, which means the construction spanned a period of **9 years**.
 
• The fort was designed by the architect **Ustad Ahmad Lahori**, the same genius who designed the **Taj Mahal** in **Agra**.
